name: LangAuto
description: LangAuto is a benchmark designed to test the ability of autonomous driving systems to handle complex language instructions and challenging driving scenarios in a closed-loop, end-to-end driving framework.
reputation: A newer autonomous driving benchmark focused on language-conditioned closed-loop driving, with emerging but limited adoption so far.
notes: Includes a dataset of approximately 64K instruction-following data clips; first work leveraging LLMs for closed-loop end-to-end autonomous driving.
